results.title: Japan defeats France to win the Pastry World Cup | CNN
results.content:
Japan defeats France to win the Pastry World Cup
PUBLISHED Jan 27, 2025, 4:44 AM ET
Team Japan accepts the winner's trophy at the Pastry World Cup 2025.
Although the 2025 event was held in Lyon, the French team did not win the gold medal, settling for silver.
Bronze went to Malaysia, the Southeast Asian country’s highest-ever result in the contest.

results.title: The United States wins the 2026 Pastry World Cup Americas -
results.content: On Saturday, July 25, the United States team, composed of François Behuet (chocolate candidate), Jordan Snider (sugar candidate), and Nicholas Forte (ice candidate), won the 2026 Pastry World Cup Americas, held in New Orleans.

results.title: Pastry World Cup 2025 Results – Chef Kevin Ashton
results.content:
At the end of January the Japanese pastry team were again winners of the Pastry World Cup in Lyon France.

results.title: What is the Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie (World Pastry Cup)? | Valrhona Chocolate
results.content:
Valrhona has been an official partner of this prestigious culinary event since 1989 and continues to show its commitment as an ambassador and partner of top-level gastronomy around the world.
The finale of the Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie is held every other year at the SIRHA trade show in Lyon, France.

results.title: Japan once again wins the Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie -
results.content: On January 24 and 25, in the impressive Paul Bocuse Hall at the Lyon exhibition center, the Japanese team won the gold medal in the Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie for the fourth time, ahead of the other 17 participating countries.
